comparison.objective: Fit two beveled steel coupons for a V-groove weld.
comparison.physical_skill: Heavy-part reorientation and precise planar alignment of bevels, ends, and root gap.
comparison.success_condition: Both coupons flat and still, bevels opposed, 1.6–3.2 mm opening at both ends, and ends aligned within 5 mm.
comparison.reason: Static weld fit-up is materially different from mechanical adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
